summary: User corrected the campaign-approval requirement: admin approval must not create automatic withdrawal history. Removed automatic withdrawal and transaction-ledger creation from all approval paths. Full, partial, and zero-point approvals now only apply the approved points. Updated iteration34 and iteration35 regression suites accordingly; 12/12 tests passed. Existing per-user withdrawal override chip fix remains intact.

success_rate.frontend: not rerun; no frontend change in this correction

rca_of_issue: The prior implementation auto-created a successful withdrawal row for partial/zero campaign approvals. User explicitly clarified this is unwanted. The approval endpoint now only persists credited_points and credits approved_points; it never inserts into withdrawals or creates a source=withdraw ledger transaction.
